messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Hi Todd, your order hasn't shipped yet. Sorry, the October 31 date I gave you last month slipped. Your Magic M. 40T on Shop···· now ships November 30, and the Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA goes in the same box.

We emailed you about the delay on November 3 and again on November 8, with photos from the factory. If you didn't see them, check your spam folder. You'll get tracking by email when it ships. You can follow the batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
